answer: Because the timing is written down against the marble challenge, the signal audit can replay the relic history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 130 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. That bill is paid per identity, so 394 aliases cost 109 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
